title: A man of genius makes no mistakes. His errors are volitional and are the portals of discovery
html_source:
Mistakes and errors occur throughout Ulysses. Characters' errors often open other meanings and explore the relationship between meaning and language hence are the portals to discovery.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZhW0TrzWGmI

Gifford, page 206 explains volitional errors were a Socratic method for disproving an opponents argument in debate.
